decision.explanation: The question asks when the album "Killswitch Engage" was released. The original sources clearly distinguish between two distinct albums titled *Killswitch Engage*: the 2000 debut album and the 2009 self-titled fifth album. Document D1S1 explicitly states that the 2000 album was released on July 4, 2000, while D2S2 confirms the 2009 album was released on June 30, 2009. These are separate releases by the same band and title, so both dates are valid and distinct answers.
